title: Bound repeated owner reads in Management NL context collection

summary.defect: Management NL context collection (_mgmt_nl_collect_context) repeatedly scanned the full Telemetry and Paper Runtime Monitoring owner collections per runtime binding across cockpit, trading_pulse, portfolio, and persona_fleet surfaces, and computed _mgmt_nl_trading_pulse_snippet twice when focus in ('all', ''). Additionally, an initial revision keyed get_context_monitoring_sessions_for_bindings by (runtime_id, binding_id) while _mgmt_nl_scoped_runtime_rows looked up by integer index.
resolution: Added ManagementService.get_context_telemetry_summaries_for_runtimes and ManagementService.get_context_monitoring_sessions_for_bindings in services/control-plane/bff/management_read_models/service.py to read list_telemetry_summaries and list_paper_runtime_monitoring_sessions at most once per batch without mock-specific capability inspection, while preserving per-runtime missing->degraded, owner-error->unavailable fail-closed semantics, and owner provenance.

Updated _project_operator_runtime_state_row_impl and _mgmt_nl_scoped_runtime_rows in services/control-plane/bff/assistant/management_service.py to batch-prefetch telemetry summaries and tuple-keyed (runtime_id, binding_id) monitoring sessions with their owner observations so both monitoring session records/provenance and unavailable monitoring observations are preserved without broad TypeError fallback wrappers.

Updated _mgmt_nl_collect_context in services/control-plane/bff/assistant/management_service.py to reuse request-scoped tenant-filtered runtime bindings, request-scoped batch telemetry summaries, and the computed trading_pulse snippet across cockpit, trading_pulse, portfolio, and persona_fleet within a single request.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: _mgmt_nl_collect_context and its helper paths do not call list_telemetry_summaries repeatedly per runtime binding during a single Management NL context collection request.
When focus includes both cockpit and trading_pulse, _mgmt_nl_trading_pulse_snippet is not computed twice for identical tenant-scoped runtime bindings within the same request.

Missing telemetry for an individual runtime still marks that runtime observation degraded, and owner exceptions (both telemetry and paper runtime monitoring) still mark the observation unavailable while tuple-keyed monitoring sessions preserve session records and owner provenance.
Both POST /bff/management/nl/ask and POST /bff/management/nl/ask/stream benefit from the bounded context read path.
Targeted tests cover multi-runtime context collection and assert bounded owner read counts plus preserved observation statuses and tenant scoping.
